summary: Feed s055_single to IDS is degraded: required VLANs 10 and 20 are completely absent (100% of packets untagged) while duplicates, one-way, drops, overload and encrypted share are healthy. IDS lacks segmentation context for detection.

findings.root_cause: Upstream TAP/SPAN or packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags before delivery to the IDS. All 20 sampled frames are untagged instead of carrying VLAN 10/20, indicating trunk configured as access, SPAN 'vlan strip' or broker policy removing tags.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation and policy context and requires full payload with both directions. Without tags it cannot attribute traffic to correct tenant/segment, misses VLAN-specific detections and lateral movement between VLAN 10/20, reducing detection coverage to effectively blind for those segments.

recommended_fix.why: Preserving/restoring 802.1Q tags end-to-end from tap through packet broker to IDS restores required VLAN 10/20 visibility so IDS can apply correct policies and detect cross-VLAN attacks.
